text:
I think of cars parked in a

parking lot

when I think of my death

I think of frying pans

when I think of my death

I think someone is making love to you

when I am not there

when I think of my death

I have trouble breathing

when I think of my death

I think of all the people waiting to die

when I think of my death

I think I will never be able to drink water again

when I think of my death

the air turns completely white

the cockroaches in my kitchen

tremble

and I think someone will have to throw

my clean and dirty underwear

very far away.

translation.title: When I Think of My Death
translation.editorial_note: The translation preserves the repeated death-thoughts and the mundane final image of discarded underwear.
